summary: V3-08 repair NOT accepted: the candidate hardens scripts/e2e-android.js against transient emulator failures, but it does NOT fix the concrete trusted finalizer blocker. The exact failure of finalizer run 35302658175 (and of the previous run 35293489693) is located via the GitHub Actions API: step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' fails with annotation 'The process /usr/bin/sh failed with exit code 2'. Root cause, proven by inspecting the exact reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 tag commit (a421e43855164a8197daf9d8d40fe71c6996bb0d): the action's parseScript() splits the multi-line script: input into individual lines and executes EACH LINE via a separate `sh -c` invocation. The workflow's emulator step script block starts with `set -euo pipefail`; Ubuntu's /bin/sh is dash, which rejects pipefail ('set: Illegal option -o pipefail') and exits with code 2. Independent simulation of the action's line-splitting reproduces the exact annotation: the step fails at line 1, before `adb install` and before `npm run e2e:android` — the E2E script NEVER RUNS in the finalizer. A secondary defect is confirmed: even without the pipefail line, `apk=$(find ...)` is lost between lines (each line is a separate shell), so `adb install -r "$apk"` would receive an empty path. The concrete blocker therefore lives in .github/workflows/chorescore-v3-finalize.yml (trusted-shell owned; the Builder is forbidden from modifying workflows), not in the E2E script. The candidate delta (1 file, scripts/e2e-android.js, +17/-6: stale-dump deletion, swipe/screencap/force-stop try/catch, launch sleep 3000->5000) is coherent, passes trusted verification (exit 0: typecheck, 21 suites/426 tests, privacy:check PASS, cost:check PASS, expo export android OK, prebuild OK, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL), touches no product code and cannot regress V3-01..V3-07, but it does not meet the active criterion. Decision: repair — retain the E2E hardening as WIP baseline; the next cycle must add scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh (Builder scope) and the trusted shell must change the workflow's emulator step to a single-line invocation (e.g. `script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh`) so the golden path actually executes.

Failed finalizer run 35302658175 inspected via GitHub Actions API: release job steps 1-6 (checkout, setup, 'Trusted product, privacy and cost gates', 'Locate and hash APK') all success; step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' failure; step 8 upload-artifact skipped; reopen-on-failure job reopened V3-08 (commit 9af2283). The step annotation is exactly 'The process /usr/bin/sh failed with exit code 2' (check-runs annotations API). The previous finalizer run 35293489693 failed at the same step with the same annotation

Root cause proven: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 (verified at the exact v2 tag commit a421e43855164a8197daf9d8d40fe71c6996bb0d, lib/script-parser.js + lib/main.js) splits the multi-line script: input into individual lines (parseScript: split on newlines, trim, drop comments/empties) and executes each line via its own `sh -c` invocation (for (const script of scripts) await exec.exec('sh', ['-c', script]))

Independent simulation of the action's line-splitting on the workflow's exact script block: line 1 `sh -c 'set -euo pipefail'` fails with 'sh: 1: set: Illegal option -o pipefail' and exit code 2 — reproducing the exact finalizer annotation. /bin/sh on Ubuntu is dash, which does not support pipefail; bash does (bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; echo ok' exits 0)

Secondary defect confirmed by simulation: even without the pipefail line, `apk=$(find ...)` runs in its own shell and the variable is lost, so the next line `adb install -r "$apk"` receives an empty path and fails — the multi-line script block cannot work under this action regardless of the first line

Candidate delta vs pristine accepted tree (/home/runner/work/_temp/accepted-pristine at 9af2283): exactly 1 file — scripts/e2e-android.js, 17 insertions / 6 deletions (stale dump file deletion in dumpUi, try/catch around swipeToTop/findVisible swipes, try/catch around screencap with screenshot:null fallback, try/catch around force-stop, launch sleep 3000->5000); diff -rq over the whole tree (excluding .git/node_modules/android/.expo/.opencode/reports) shows only scripts/e2e-android.js differing; git status shows only scripts/e2e-android.js staged plus the untracked trusted verification report

The candidate does NOT fix the concrete blocker: the E2E script never executes in the finalizer (the workflow fails at line 1 of its script block before adb install and before npm run e2e:android). The blocker is in .github/workflows/chorescore-v3-finalize.yml lines 84-94 (script: | block), which is trusted-shell owned — AGENTS.md forbids the Builder from modifying workflows, and TASKS.json scope states 'Protected control-plane files remain trusted-shell owned'

node --check scripts/e2e-android.js exits 0 (syntax valid); the hardening changes are sound on their own merits and do not weaken product assertions: assertAbsent still throws when a forbidden label is present on a successful dump, waitFor still throws on genuine timeout, findVisible still throws when the label is not found after attempts; the screenshot:null fallback only affects evidence capture, not assertions

No product code touched: src/, app/, __tests__/, docs/, governance/, directives/ are byte-identical to the pristine accepted tree, so no V3-01..V3-07 regression is possible; all 426 tests across 21 suites pass in the trusted verification

No prohibited patterns in the delta: no chrono, premium, paywall, subscription, entitlement, upsell, warm V2 design tokens, provider coupling, destructive history/reset, silent unit conversion, cross-currency netting, implicit cross-ledger compensation, fake integration, or accessibility/offline/error regression

findings.path: .github/workflows/chorescore-v3-finalize.yml (step 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path', script: | block lines 84-94)
findings.problem: The concrete trusted finalizer blocker: the emulator step's multi-line script block is executed line-by-line by reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 (each line via a separate `sh -c`), and line 1 `set -euo pipefail` fails in dash (Ubuntu /bin/sh) with 'set: Illegal option -o pipefail' and exit code 2. The step therefore fails before `adb install` and before `npm run e2e:android` — the E2E golden path never runs. This is the exact failure of finalizer runs 35293489693 and 35302658175 (annotation 'The process /usr/bin/sh failed with exit code 2'). Even if line 1 were removed, the `apk=$(find ...)` variable is lost between lines (separate shells), so `adb install -r "$apk"` would receive an empty path.
findings.evidence: GitHub Actions API: both finalizer runs failed at step 7 with annotation 'The process /usr/bin/sh failed with exit code 2' (check-runs annotations). Action source at the exact v2 tag commit a421e43855164a8197daf9d8d40fe71c6996bb0d: lib/script-parser.js splits on newlines; lib/main.js runs each line via exec.exec('sh', ['-c', script]). Independent simulation: `sh -c 'set -euo pipefail'` → 'sh: 1: set: Illegal option -o pipefail', exit 2; simulation of the full block fails at line 1 with exit 2; simulation without line 1 fails at `adb install -r "$apk"` with an empty path.
findings.requiredFix: Change the workflow's emulator step to invoke the golden path as a SINGLE line so the action cannot split it, e.g. `script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh` (or a single-line `bash -euo pipefail -c '...'`). The workflow file is trusted-shell owned; the Builder provides scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh containing: set -euo pipefail; apk=$(find android/app/build/outputs/apk/release -type f -name '*.apk' | head -1); adb install -r "$apk"; npm run e2e:android. The E2E script already auto-locates the APK and skips install when the package is present, so the script file only needs the same logic in one shell.
findings.verification: A trusted finalizer run passes step 7 end-to-end on an API 35 emulator: adb install succeeds, `npm run e2e:android` executes and exits 0, and the golden-path checkpoints (login, groups, tabs, add, balances, todos, back-to-add) are recorded.

findings.problem: The candidate does not meet the active criterion: it hardens the E2E script against transient emulator failures (stale dump deletion, swipe/screencap/force-stop try/catch, longer launch sleep), but the script never executes in the finalizer because the workflow fails at line 1 of its script block (see workflow finding). The finalizer would fail again with exit code 2 even with this candidate applied.
findings.evidence: Simulation of the action's line-splitting on the workflow's exact script block fails at line 1 (`set -euo pipefail`, exit 2) before any adb or npm command runs; the candidate delta touches only scripts/e2e-android.js; the workflow file is byte-identical on main and lab and unchanged by the candidate.
findings.requiredFix: In the next cycle, add the workflow-compatible invocation path: create scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh (Builder scope) with the install + golden-path logic in a single shell, and have the trusted shell change the workflow's emulator step to `script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh`. Keep the E2E hardening — it is necessary once the script actually runs, and it is coherent (no regressions, trusted verification exit 0).
findings.verification: Finalizer step 7 passes end-to-end on a real API 35 emulator with the workflow change and the script file; the hardened E2E script survives transient uiautomator dump / swipe / screencap failures while still failing on genuine golden-path violations.
